item.title: Starmer warns heating oil firms as he visits Belfast over cost-of-living pressures

item.title: Mulholland warns DUP proposed welfare cuts would hit North Antrim families during energy crisis
item.description: North Antrim Alliance MLA Sian Mulholland Families across North Antrim could face deeper hardship if welfare spending is reduced to boost defence funding, according to Alliance MLA Sian Mulholland. The party’s poverty spokesperson said calls from senior DUP figures to divert money away from welfare budgets were “catastrophically out of touch” with the pressures facing households during the ongoing energy crisis. item.title: Man charged after report of child approached in Co Antrim
item.description: A 58-year-old man has been charged with stalking and child abduction following a report of a man approaching a child in Whitehead earlier this week. Police confirmed the charges relate to an incident reported in the Belfast Road area of Whitehead on Tuesday, March 10. The man is due to appear before Belfast Magistrates’ Court on Thursday, March 12. item.title: Northern Ireland men denied life-saving prostate cancer drug available across UK
item.description: North Antrim MP Jim Allister and Health Minister Mike Nesbitt Men in Northern Ireland with prostate cancer are being denied access to a life-extending drug already available to patients across the rest of the UK — prompting warnings of a “postcode lottery” that could cost lives. The drug, abiraterone, is prescribed across the UK for men with advanced prostate cancer that has spread. item.title: Child escapes injury in suspected deliberate house fire in Moneymore
item.description: A man has been arrested after a suspected deliberate house fire in Moneymore left one man injured and forced neighbouring residents from their homes. Emergency services were called to the incident in the Rockview Park area shortly before 2pm on Thursday, March 12, after reports that a property had caught fire while people were inside.
